title: CTEs reference solution
answer: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)) SELECT month, revenue FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY month;
